# finalproject

## Comparative Analysis of Anthropometric Measurements Across Mendeley and NHANES

This repository contains the final project for **BST260 (Fall 2026)** at
the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

The project investigates anthropometric measurements using two publicly
available datasets: the Mendeley Body Measurements dataset and the
National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), August
2021–August 2023.

## Project Objectives

The main objectives of this project are:

- Explore distributions of age, height, and waist circumference.
- Examine associations between demographic characteristics and
  anthropometric measurements.
- Compare data quality and measurement characteristics across the two
  datasets.
- Identify challenges associated with integrating datasets collected
  from different populations and using different measurement protocols.
- Apply R programming, statistical analysis, and data visualization to
  generate reproducible findings.

## Datasets

**1. Mendeley Body Measurements Dataset**

Contains anthropometric measurements primarily from children and
adolescents.

**2. NHANES (August 2021–August 2023)**

Contains standardized anthropometric measurements and demographic
information from participants in the U.S. National Health and Nutrition
Examination Survey.

## Methods

The project will use R for data cleaning, descriptive statistics,
exploratory data analysis, visualization, and statistical modeling.

Two Quarto vignettes will document the analyses, findings, and
limitations of each dataset.

## Project Website

The project website will be published using the `pkgdown` R package and
GitHub Pages.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://tongtong24x.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://tongtong24x.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://tongtong24x.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://tongtong24x.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
